results.title: Prince Harry says he wants to work out relationship with brother and father
results.description: Prince Harry is saying he wants to mend his relationships with Prince William and King Charles III.

results.title: ESMA: Chandigarh prohibits power firm staffers from going on strike for 6 months
results.description: The order, issued by the home department on October 19, declares employment with CPDL an essential service under Section 3 of the Act, as extended to Chandigarh, and prohibits strikes under Section 4A for six months from the date of issuance

results.title: NYS court officers unions back Blakeman in rare governor endorsement: ‘It’s about public safety’
results.description: The Empire State unions representing court officers are endorsing Bruce Blakeman for governor, the first time they have chimed in on the race in at least 20 years.
